data.name: Deendyal
data.gender_notes: Deendyal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deendyal means 'Heavenly' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'deen', which means 'heaven'. This name is often given to boys born into families who are believed to have a divine connection or who are destined for greatness. The name Deendyal carries the meaning “Heavenly” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Deendyal usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Deendyal is a sacred name that symbolizes wisdom, strength, and divine connection. It is a powerful reminder of the eternal connection between the soul and the divine.
data.etymology: Deendyal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deendyal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
